mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_CATEGORY (CATEGORY_ID, USER_ID, TYPE, NAME, SOURCE) VALUES (nextval('SEQ_USER_CATEGORY'), #{userId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", USER_ID AS "userId", TYPE AS "type", NAME AS "name", SOURCE AS "source", CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM USER_CATEGORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TYPE = #{type}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_CATEGORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TYPE = #{type} AND NAME = #{name} AND SOURCE = #{source}
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY AS "category", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM MYTRANS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND TYPE = #{type} AND CATEGORY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CATEGORY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
